# VERDICT FAIL - PR #336

Basis: 1119b535f7cd7bac87f1da0931e5ff2cfbd4a559, origin/main...HEAD.
The abbd0b5a..1119b535 delta changes only the authority documentation and
the skill sensor's pinned sentence; the reviewed Rust is unchanged.
`just pr-freeze 336` reported FINAL at this full head: CLEAN, all five
latest checks passed, ready, no migration conflict, Delivers accepted.
This is the single review round, covering correctness, cost and security.

## Findings

1. **P2 - Close records a completed override even when its CAS refuses.**
   `crates/daemon/src/http/lifecycle.rs:648-663` commits
   `seat.prime-override` before the independently committed
   `tombstone_if_unchanged` at line 676. A seat's normal end-of-turn
   activity/context write changes the row between the expected-row read and
   the CAS. The close then returns `E-RS-INCARNATION-CHANGED`, leaving the
   seat live but a durable `operation: close` override fact. The existing
   held-close retry loop (`crates/daemon/src/http/memory_turn.rs:593-620`)
   explicitly expects this race and can append several override facts for
   one eventual close. Commit the override fact and guarded tombstone in
   the same owned transaction, or explicitly distinguish attempted/refused
   actions from committed acts. A regression should force an intervening
   activity write and assert no completed-override fact on a refused CAS.

2. **P2 - The expanded actor predicate is not used to protect a project-prime target.**
   `crates/store/src/role_assertion.rs:335-340` lets an acting prime bypass
   a live foreign parent, then checks the target with old `is_prime`,
   which only recognizes machine designation and role assertions
   (`:77-83`), not `projects.prime_id` as new `acts_as_prime` does (`:94-103`).
   Given project B's designated prime with no `prime` role and a live parent,
   an unrelated prime can now link it as a worker and take its parent,
   despite AC1/non-goals saying prime targets still refuse. The old path
   refused this live-parent takeover. Protect targets using the same
   approved definition of prime and add this live-parent, project-only
   designation case.

## Resolved scope

- Role-only primes are deliberately authorized. The prime confirmed direct
  Jordan approval and a role-only motivating caller. This is not a finding.
- `docs/how/pij-rs-api.md:289` now names the approved role-only-prime
  link/close exception.
- No in-scope external-account security vulnerability found by the bounded
  static security assessment. Same-user threats are excluded.
- No new per-tick work or launch. Alt inference is per registration;
  backfill is one pass after the daemon owns its port and before serving.

## Evidence

- `git diff --check origin/main...HEAD`: passed.
- `just pij-skill-check`: passed at 1119b535 (one pre-existing advisory
  protocol line-budget warning).
- `harness boot --json`: advisory NOT-READY (dependency-free review worktree).
- The following exact shared-build invocation passed at niceness 19,
  four jobs, with the reviewed Rust unchanged at FINAL:

  `PIJ_SHARED_TARGET="$(bash harness/scripts/cargo-target.sh)" just shared-build -- test --locked -p pij-daemon --test prime_override_http --then test --locked -p pij-daemon --lib alt --then clippy --locked -p pij-daemon -p pij-harnesses -p pij-store --all-targets -- -D warnings`

  Override tests: 3 passed. Alt-selected unit tests: 5 passed, including
  registration inference and one-shot backfill. macOS clippy: passed.
- Latest CI run 44970413200: check (22), check (24), rust-lint and
  rust-test passed. Delivers run 44970413172 passed. TS proof is CI-only;
  no dependencies were installed and no full local harness pass is claimed.
- Initial CI check failure was the stale skill sensor requiring
  "Close requires self or the current recorded parent."; fixed at 1119b535.

## Harness gift

**magicWand:** The completed-close audit invariant needs a regression that interleaves a
normal activity write with the close CAS. This would turn the existing F194
race knowledge into deterministic protection for the new audit fact.

**difficulties:** Positive actor-prime tests did not cover project-only
prime targets; normal activity/CAS races did not exercise the new audit.
The stale authority documentation was clarified with the prime and fixed,
along with the skill sensor, in 1119b535.
